Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Account Executive (Dutch-speaking) (m/f/d) Your Role

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. And when the pipeline dries out, you don't wait around: you go on the hunt for deals.

What to expect

 * Inbound demos: 8-16 qualified demo calls per day

 * Quota ownership: clear monthly and quarterly targets

 * Pipeline management: structured follow-ups and clean CRM hygiene

 * Help sharpen our sales motion as we scale fast

Who We're Looking For

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

 * Proven closing track record along a structured funnel

 * High discipline, strong ownership, and a genuine hunger to earn

 * Natural communicator and storyteller

 * Native or C2 Dutch; strong English. German is a big plus

 * Ready for a paid temporary relocation (around 2 months in Vienna to soak up our culture)

What We Offer

 * €70.000-€120.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Relocation bonus (in case you want to stay in Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy

 * Regular team offsites

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 45 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a demo simulation

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

SAL is looking for an experienced Business Developer for our Research Division Power Electronics, developing new business areas and sales markets, maintaining existing ones, and sourcing new customers and partners. You will play a key role in promoting the SAL brand and represent the company at national and international events. You will collaborate closely with the division's management, business developers and researchers. 1 (Senior) Expert - Business Development (all genders) 

Your future tasks include:

 * Acquisition of R&D projects for Power Electronics, focusing on highly efficient, power-dense converters for various applications.

 * Development of business opportunities and directions, including finding new markets and researching their demands.

 * Co-developing the division's research strategy with senior researchers - providing insight into current trends and expected developments in the industry and identifying opportunities and challenges.

 * Key account management for premium partners.

 * Developing and shaping service offerings for contract research with the team.

 * Supporting the acquisition of R&D projects for other SAL divisions in collaboration with other business developers.

 * Liaising with the marketing and PR teams, as well as researchers, to create marketing campaigns and update the division's website. This includes planning conference visits and demonstrations.

 * Representing the division at internal and external events.

 * Organisation and management of trade show booths

 * Developing quotes and proposals for clients.

Your profile:

 * Completed education in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and ideally a background in Power Electronics (MSc., PhD)

 * 3+ years of experience in a relevant industry (Electronics, Mechatronics, Power Electronics) in Business Development, Sales, or Marketing

Experience and a proven track record in project acquisition and key account management

 * Entrepreneurial, strategic mindset with experience in strategy development and a strong network in the Austrian and European ecosystem would be a great advantage

 * Fluency in German and English, with excellent communication skills

 * Solid market understanding of power electronics applications and awareness of industry trends and opportunities

Important Facts about SAL:

 * Diverse research activities with many technical challenges.

 * State-of-the-art laboratory facilities and equipment.

 * Location in the heart of Europe in Austria - relocation support for non-European nationalities.

 * Internal and external training opportunities for career development.

 * Family & children friendly - actively shaping the compatibility of family and career.

 * "Vital4SAL" to promote a healthy workplace (e.g. SAL coaching pool, trainings on mental health, physical activities, healthy snacks, 24/7 accident insurance)

 * € 4 per day meal allowance in restaurants or € 2 per working day in supermarkets.

 * Public transport initiative (subsidy for the "Klimaticket")

 * Our values: Open door policy, flexibility in working hours, casual dress code, diverse teams, working with people of different nationalities, informal communication, lifelong learning, compatibility of family and career, sustainability, personal growth, and collective advancement.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group E (E1 salary = EUR 4.056,00 paid 14 times a year) based on 38,5 hours per week). For this position we offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your experience and qualifications.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 UI/UX Designer (m/f/d) Your role

You own how fonio feels on the web. Our website is our most important storefront - and right now it's not where it needs to be. You don't build one nice page, you build a system: a design system and landing page templates that roll out into localized pages across 9+ markets. Continuous optimization, not a one-off redesign. You design and ship - you own the build end-to-end, not a handoff to engineering. We're building an AI operating system for SMBs - people should feel that on the website.

What to expect

 * You own the design and continuous optimization of our website and landing pages

 * You build a scalable design system with reusable components

 * You develop landing page templates that localize across all markets (DACH, FR, IT, ES, UK, PL, US, and more)

 * You design and ship live yourself - full ownership from concept to published page

 * You think in user journey, conversion, and responsive design

 * You work closely with the Creative Director on brand direction

Who we're looking for

 * Several years of experience as a UI/UX or web designer focused on converting websites (portfolio required)

 * You think in systems and components, not individual pages

 * You build and ship yourself

 * Experience with design systems and localization across multiple markets

 * You understand conversion and think in journeys

 * German + good English

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €65,000-€90,000

 * Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 SEO Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You are fonio's in-house SEO lead. Your job: make us rank #1 on Google and in AI search tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) for every relevant query, not just in DACH but internationally. You own strategy and execution, guide the website team on how pages should be structured, and set the direction for keyword research across all markets. We'll work with agencies here and there, but the expertise lives with you.

What to expect

 * Own SEO strategy and execution across all our markets, starting with DACH and expanding internationally

 * Define how pages are built and structured, working closely with the website and engineering teams on technical SEO

 * Lead keyword research and decide how we go after both traditional search and AI-generated results

 * Commission or write the content needed to rank

 * Manage a €20.000-€30.000/month SEO budget

 * Work with external agencies where it makes sense, but hold the strategy yourself

Who We're Looking For

Must-have:

 * You've built SEO at real scale before, full-time. Not "co-owned SEO alongside other things" but SEO as your main job, with results to show for it. Industry (tech, consumer, anything) matters less than the scale you've operated at.

 * International SEO experience, you know how to approach markets beyond your home market

 * Fluent in English and German

Nice-to-have:

 * Strong copywriting skills (an SEO person who can write well is rare and valuable)

 * Hands-on with website tools like Webflow or similar

What We Offer

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 People Operations Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You own everything after a candidate signs, from contracts through offboarding, and automate as much of it as possible. We are looking for someone to build the structural backbone to enable rapid scaling.

 * Contracts & onboarding: Manage employment contracts for all employees (direct and indirect employment), organize equipment, accounts, workspaces, and support relocation of international colleagues.

 * HR tooling & automation: introduce and own an HRIS tool, automate workflows across systems.

 * Payroll: Organize and own internal payroll processes, including variable compensation calculation of all sales teams.

 * Compliance & people legal: Support international hiring (EU and non-EU), time-tracking, collective agreements, international taxation topics, etc.

 * Compensation: Manage and monitor compensation bands across teams/countries.

 * Events & culture: Organize internal and external events (hackathons, off-sites, etc.)

 * Offboarding: Manage offboarding of employees.

 * Later, people development: Design feedback cycles, L&D, career development (e.g. SDR academy).

What to Expect

 * Solo, end-to-end ownership of everything people operations.

 * Hands-on operational work to build the foundation for automation/scaling.

 * Direct impact: your work has immediate influence on the culture of fonio.

 * Flat hierarchies: close collaboration across departments.

What You Bring

 * 3+ year of People Ops, HR, or Operations experience, ideally startup or scale-up.

 * Knowledge about Austrian labor law, payroll, and collective agreements

 * Structured, hands-on working style.

 * AI and automation/workflow skills.

 * People-first, low ego. You thrive under intensity.

 * German native, strong English.

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €80,000

 * Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Head of Finance (m/f/d) Your Role

As Head of Finance, you own the entire finance operation behind one of Europe's fastest-growing companies, across our entities in Europe and the US.

 * Own accounting for all entities: pre-accounting in-house, full ownership of our accounting stack, and the transition to fully in-house accounting in 2027.

 * Run controlling: month-end, quarterly and annual closings, revenue reporting down to the invoice line item, cost and profit center reporting.

 * Own tax: VAT and sales tax, employment tax and contributions, international tax, and transfer pricing between entities.

 * Own cash flow and treasury: planning, forecasting, cash reserves, return optimization, intercompany transfers and FX.

 * Roll out a lean ERP and turn everything manual in finance into workflows and AI agents.

 * Build and lead the finance team, starting with your first hire shortly after you join.

 * Work directly with both founders and the extended leadership team.

What We Offer

 * Up to €130,000 + equity package.

 * On-site in Vienna, relocation package if needed.

 * Real ownership from day one

 * Everything you need to be successful. If you need it, you get it.

What You Bring

 * You were part of building a finance in a fast-growing company, internationally, across different jurisdictions and accounting regulations. (ideally: VC-backed B2B SaaS/Tech)

 * You have run closings and accounting prep yourself, not just reviewed them.

 * You are experienced across controlling, tax, cash flow and treasury.

 * Workflows, agents and automations are your default, not the exception. Claude Code, n8n and similar tools are part of your toolkit.

 * Obsession with detail: small errors bother you before they bother anyone else.

 * Perfect German, very good English.

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro Call

 * 15 min Intro Call with our Chief of Staff

 * 45 min Skill Interview & Case Study Discussion

 * On-Site Meeting in Vienna

 * 20 min Culture Call with the founders

As Ex Commercial Founder at fonio, you own one of our products. You're not just shaping the roadmap; you're accountable for the commercial success of the product. Strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and growth all sit with you.

You'll operate like a mini-CEO for your product: making the calls, running the experiments, and carrying the numbers. You won't do it alone: you're paired with a technical counterpart and together you own the product.

What you'll do

 * Own a product - from strategy and roadmap to go-to-market and revenue

 * Define positioning, pricing, and the commercial strategy for your product

 * Work directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship and grow fast

 * Own the metrics that matter - adoption, retention, and revenue - and be accountable for them

 * Run discovery: talk to customers, validate problems, and decide what gets built

 * Up to €150.000 OTE + equity.

 * On-site in Vienna, Munich, Barcelona or London - relocation package to Vienna if needed.

 * Real ownership of a fonio product: you get to essentially work like an entrepreneur inside of fonio.

 * Maximum autonomy - you run your product like your own company.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.

What You Bring

 * Demonstrated track record as a founder or commercial owner - you've built and launched a B2B SaaS product & owned it end to end from the commercial side.

 * Strong commercial instinct: you think in terms of markets, customers, and revenue

 * Comfortable operating with high ambiguity and no predefined structure

 * Sharp analytical thinking paired with a bias for execution

 * Excellent communication in English; German is a strong plus given our DACH focus

 * Bonus: experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, or voice technology

SAL is looking for an experienced IC-Design Flow Engineer within the Chip Design Team. As such, you will contribute to building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable IC-Design flows from architectural validation through sign-off for advanced ASIC/SoC projects. You will work together both with internal staff as well as external partners and customers to ensure a robust and effective development environment offering a flexible and modular tool chain that can be easily adapted to different technologies, EDA Vendors and applications.

Your future tasks include:
 * Ownership of projects design set-up by configuring and initializing end-to-end EDA environments, managing tool licenses, and ensuring seamless integration across multiple PDKs and technology nodes.
 * Improvements of existing flow methodologies and creation of new ones, utilization of version-controlled repositories to guarantee reproducibility, auditability, and smooth cross-team collaboration.
 * Definition of automation scripts and CI/CD pipelines that streamline synthesis, DFT, verification, and physical implementation processes.
 * Providing hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting support to design and verification teams on EDA tool usage, performance tuning, and debugging.
 * Identifying bottlenecks and inefficiencies in existing workflows, proposing and implementing scalable solutions to reduce time-to-tapeout and improve productivity.
 * Managing PDK integration, EDA tool upgrades, and license optimization while ensuring strict compliance with foundry requirements and internal quality standards.
 * Maintaining robust, well-documented flow configurations and script libraries, enabling rapid onboarding and consistent project execution.
 * Overseeing flow validation across benchmark and production projects, ensuring accuracy, repeatability, and alignment with milestone targets.
 * Supporting cross-site as well as partner & customers engineering teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.

Your profile:
 * A master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field.
 * A solid technical understanding of digital/analog IC development methodologies, combined with hands-on experience with major EDA platforms (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens/Mentor, etc.).
 * At least 3 years' industrial experience as an IC Design Flow Engineer or in a similar role supporting multi-site ASIC/SoC design teams.
 * Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, Tcl, Perl, Bash) and familiarity with version control and CI/CD systems (Git, Jenkins, etc.).
 * A structured working approach, a proactive mindset, and strong problem-solving skills.
 * The ability to quickly understand complex technical aspects related to EDA Flow and suggest improvements.
 * Excellent command of English, spoken and written; German is a plus.

1 Senior Research Engineer - Cross-Platform Microfabrication Processes (all genders) As part of the European Chips Act, Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) is driving innovation in quantum and semiconductor technologies through its Pilot Lines. 

Join our interdisciplinary teams at the interface of technology and fabrication and enjoy Villach's exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Austrian Alps. Be part of something bigger. Be part of Silicon Austria Labs.

The role is part of the new Pilot Line Operations (PLO) Team within the Microsystem Division. PLO is a multidisciplinary engineering team bridging research and pilot-line operations, combining microfabrication expertise, process integration, documentation and coordination between Research Units and the SAL cleanroom infrastructure.

Your future tasks include:
 * Hands-on execution of microfabrication processes across lithography, deposition, etching, cleaning, metrology and other relevant process modules.
 * Develop, integrate, troubleshoot and optimize complex microfabrication process flows, including cross-tool and cross-module interactions.
 * Execute and lead fabrication runs, analyze results and identify process integration issues, deviations and root causes: pilot-line runs, MPWs, technology demonstrators and external fabrication activities.
 * Assessing Technology and pilot-line maturity.
 * Work directly with scientists to translate new research concepts into fabricable process flows and experimental process runs.
 * Work closely with cleanroom tool owners and engineers to ensure compatibility with tool capabilities, cleanroom constraints and operational requirements.
 * Define and maintain process documentation, flow diagrams, process specifications, run sheets, recipes, track of changes and lessons learned.
 * Help establish standardized ways of working for process development, integration, documentation, qualification and scale-up.
 * Platform Specialization: Focusing primarily on one of the key Microsystems technology platforms (Quantum Technologies, Photonics, PiezoMEMS, Magnetic Microsystems) but operating across multiple projects.

Your profile:
 * MSc/PhD in microelectronics, microsystems, semiconductors, physics or a related field.
 * 5+ years of hands-on experience in semiconductor, MEMS, photonics or microfabrication technology, preferably in a cleanroom industrial environment.
 * Demonstrated expertise in fabrication process development and integration, with the ability to execute and troubleshoot processes. 
 * Broad understanding of multiple microfabrication modules and their interactions, rather than expertise limited to a single process step. 
 * Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to move between hands-on cleanroom work, process engineering, documentation and coordination. 
 * Strong organizational and documentation skills for technical reporting and professional documentation. 
 * Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively while supporting multiple stakeholders.
 * Excellent teamwork, communication, reporting, and organizational skills. 
 * Excellent oral and written communication skills in English (German is a plus)

1 Expert, Science and Technology (F/M/D) Job ID: REQ-10085657

As an Expert in the Method Development Team in Process Analytical Sciences (PAS), you will be responsible for physicochemical method development, optimization, and robustness testing in late-phase pharmaceutical drug development. Using state-of-the-art technologies and scientific expertise, you will support Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) process development within a multidisciplinary project team. We are seeking an experienced scientist with strong analytical expertise, proficiency in data and digital tools, and comprehensive knowledge of DS and DP process development.

The role combines experimental laboratory work with technical documentation. The ideal candidate should therefore be comfortable working both in and outside the laboratory.

This position is limited to an 18-month fixed term.

Standort: Österreich / Schaftenau

This role is based in Schaftenau, Austria. Novartis cannot offer relocation support; please apply only if the location is accessible to you.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, organize, perform, and document physicochemical method development, including HPLC and CE, in compliance with internal quality and HSE standards.
· Use chromatographic, statistical, and other software tools to increase efficiency.
· Support the implementation, handover, and transfer of analytical methods
· Collaborate with PAS laboratories, Analytical Experts, and cross-functional teams to ensure effective analytical workflows.
· Design and execute physicochemical analytical approaches for DS, DP, and process intermediates in accordance with Quality by Design principles.
· Interpret analytical results and apply data and digital solutions to improve efficiency. 
· Author and review scientific reports, support regulatory submissions
· Manage multiple priorities, communicate challenges proactively, and resolve complex issues.
· Promote knowledge sharing, present results internally, and contribute to publications, presentations, and patents.
· Evaluate new analytical technologies, develop innovative methods using DoE principles, and ensure alignment with scientific standards. 

What You Will Bring to the Role

· University degree in pharmaceutical technology, biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry, chemical engineering, or another relevant natural science discipline.
· At least 2 years of experience with an MSc or 1 year with a PhD in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry.
· Knowledge of Analytical Development.
· Expertise in biologics DS and DP process development using QbD principles.
· Excellent collaboration skills, including communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.
· Proficiency in written and spoken English; German is beneficial.
· Strong proficiency in digital technologies.

Rewards

In addition to a market-competitive base salary, we offer an attractive incentive program, a modern company pension scheme, childcare facilities, learning and development opportunities, and worldwide career opportunities within the Novartis group.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO paragraph

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment with diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Adjustments for Applicants with Disabilities

If you require an adjustment during the recruitment process because of a medical condition, physical disability, or neurodiverse condition, contact disabilities.austria@novartis.com with details of your request and your contact information.
